source_of_truth: Read by hand: invoices/index.ts re-exports from its OWN internal/ files (same module, so re-exporting through your own public entry is correct); reports imports invoices only through invoices/index.ts (the public entry, e.to === the index). No cross-module edge targets a private file, so a correct auditor reports nothing.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the index re-exports from its own module's internal/ files; a module publishing its own internals through its own public entry is the intended barrel pattern, not a cross-module leak
reports imports from ~/features/invoices, which resolves to invoices/index.ts (the public entry), not to any private file
invoices is a business domain, not shared/ code; re-exporting its own internals is not shared depending on a domain
